content.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי בֹא עָנָו בְּתוֹךְ אֵשׁ וְלַֽהַב,
content.english: After the humble one entered the fire and flame,

content.hebrew: הוֹדִיעוֹ יוי לֵאמֹר לְעַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַדֵּב מֵאֲשֶׁר לָהֶם יָהַב,
content.transliteration: Hodi‘o Adonai lemor le‘ammo lehitnaddev me’asher lahem yahav,
content.english: Adonai said to tell His people to donate freely from what He had given them—

content.hebrew: לְהָבִיא תְרוּמָה מֵאֲשֶׁר חֲנָנָם בְּרַֽהַב,
content.english: To bring a contribution from what He had graciously given them at Rahav,

content.hebrew: קהל: רֹאשׁ כָּל־בֹּֽשֶׂם וְכָל־אֶֽבֶן יְקָרָה וְזָהָב.  (יחזקאל כז:כב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Rosh kol bosem vekhol even yeḳara vezahav.
content.english: Cong. Every finest spice, every precious gem, and gold. (Ezek. 27:22)

content.hebrew: הוֹפַֽעְתִּי לָךְ, עֲדָתִי, וָאֶתְּנָה צְמִידִים עַל יָדָֽיִךְ,
content.english: I have appeared to you, My community, and have placed bracelets on your hands,

content.hebrew: עִתֵּךְ עֵת דֹּדִים, וָאֶפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפִי עָלָֽיִךְ,
content.english: Your time is one of loving, and I have spread my garment over you.

content.hebrew: עֲשִׂי לִי מִשְׁכָּן, מֵאֲשֶׁר שַֽׂמְתִּי בְּעִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ,
content.english: Make Me a Tabernacle, from what I have set among your wares—

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי כָּלִיל הוּא בַּהֲדָרִי אֲשֶׁר שַֽׂמְתִּי עָלָֽיִךְ.  (יחזקאל טז:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki kalil hu bahadari asher samti ‘alayikh.
content.english: Cong. For it is splendid with My beauty, which I have bestowed upon you. (Ezek. 16:14)

content.hebrew: רָאוֹת רַבּוֹת, עָנָו, עֵינֶֽיךָ תִרְאֶֽינָה:
content.english: Many sights, humble one, your eyes will see:

content.hebrew: צוּרַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְכֵלָיו – יָדֶֽיךָ תְכַלֶּֽנָּה.
content.english: The form of the Tabernacle and its vessels, which your hands will complete.

content.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מַרְאֶה אֹתְךָ – אָזְנֶֽיךָ תִשְׁמַֽעְנָה,
content.transliteration: Kekhol asher ani mar’ē otekha – oznekha tishma‘na,
content.english: In accordance with all that I show you, your ears will hear,

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי לְמַֽעַן הַרְאוֹתְכָה הוּבָֽאתָה הֵֽנָּה.   (יחזקאל מ:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki lema‘an har’otekha huvata hennah.
content.english: Cong. For it was to show you this that you have been brought here. (Ezek. 40:4)

content.hebrew: נְוֵה הָאָרוֹן וְכַפֹּֽרֶת וּכְרוּבִים – מְקוֹם כֵּס אֵל,
content.transliteration: Nevē ha’aron vekhapporet ukheruvim – meḳom kes el,
content.english: The dwelling of the Ark, [its] cover, and [its] cherubim—the place of God’s throne;

content.hebrew: שֻׁלְחָן מְצֻפֶּה וּמְנוֹרָה וְכֵלֶֽיהָ, כָּל־אֵל,
content.transliteration: Shulkhan metsuppē umnora vekheleha, kol el,
content.english: The [gold-]plated table, and the candelabrum, and its vessels—all these.

content.hebrew: דְּמוּת הָרָקִֽיעַ, מִלְּבַד הַהַרְאֵל,
content.english: [All this] in heaven’s likeness, aside from the altar—

content.hebrew: קהל: הַגֵּד אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל. (יחזקאל מ:ד –המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Hagged et kol asher atta ro’ē levet Yisra’el.
content.english: Cong. Tell all that you see to the House of Israel.  (ibid., cont.)

content.hebrew: חֻקּוֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ בְּעַד עַמִּי לְבַדָּם,
content.english: The laws of the altar are for My people alone.

content.hebrew: בָּנוּי בְּפֶֽתַח מִשְׁכָּנִי לִהְיוֹת נֶגְדָּם,
content.english: [It will be] built at the entrance to My Tabernacle, to be facing them,

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר פִּשְׁעָם וְלִסְלֽוֹחַ בַּדָּם,
content.english: To atone for their iniquity, and effect forgiveness through blood,

content.hebrew: קהל: לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וְלִזְרוֹק עָלָיו דָּם.  (יחזקאל מג:יח)
content.english: Cong. To offer a burnt offering upon it, and to throw blood on it. (Ezek. 43:18)

content.hebrew: זִכְרוֹן מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ לֹא יָמִישׁ,
content.english: May the memory of our Temple never depart;

content.hebrew: יִבְנֵֽהוּ בִּנְיָן מְשֻׁכְלָל, זִיווֹ כַּתַּרְשִׁישׁ,
content.english: May He build it as a magnificently constructed building, whose glow is like citrine.

content.hebrew: לָבוֹא אֶל הַר צִיּוֹן יָחִישׁ,
content.english: May He hasten to come to Mount Zion,

content.hebrew: קהל: מִמְּקוֹמוֹ לֹא יָמִישׁ.     (ישעיה מו:ז)
content.english: Cong. And from His place never depart.    (Isa. 46:7)

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon nir’a bikhvodo:
content.english: Cantor: For Adonai has built Zion; he has appeared in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
